answer: Give every new identity a falcon probation: before it may earn, it must finish small, randomly assigned tasks that peers re-run and score against an ivory-clear public rubric, while a willow-flexible grace period lets honest newcomers learn the rules. Each fake identity must therefore pay the full price of real, checked work, and peers who vouch for fakes lose their own standing, so spawning a thousand Sybils costs a thousand agents' worth of genuine effort, which erases the profit of the attack.
